name: Lucio Soares
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Pilot with the SG Squadron
Birthplace: Portugal (Lisbon)

A boy who's as bright as the sun. 
He's the type to rush in at the first thought of an action. He is able to read the mood and act quickly however.
A real glutton, he's always getting in fights with the cooks about the food portions.
